description: This file contains the implementation of recap-related functionalities for the Mattermost server, including creating, retrieving, updating, regenerating, deleting recaps, and processing channels for recaps with post summarization.

methods.name: CreateRecap
methods.description: Creates a new recap job for specified channels after validating permissions and saving recap data.

methods.name: GetRecap
methods.description: Retrieves a recap by its ID, including associated channels.

methods.name: GetRecapsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all recaps for a specific user with pagination.

methods.name: MarkRecapAsRead
methods.description: Marks a recap as read and updates its timestamp.

methods.name: RegenerateRecap
methods.description: Regenerates an existing recap by resetting its status and creating a new background job.

methods.name: ProcessRecapChannel
methods.description: Processes a single channel for a recap, fetching posts, summarizing, and saving the recap channel record.

methods.name: fetchPostsForRecap
methods.description: Fetches recent posts after the last viewed timestamp, enriches with user info, and limits the number of posts.

methods.name: extractPostIDs
methods.description: Extracts post IDs from a list of post objects.
